# Billy McComiskey — Original Compositions Archive

> A static, client-side digital archive of the original musical compositions of
> Billy McComiskey, NEA National Heritage Fellow and master Irish traditional
> accordionist. Each composition carries sheet music (ABC notation), playable
> audio, credits, and the historical story behind it.

This file is generated from the canonical dataset at build time, so it always
matches the live catalog. It is intended for machine consumers (LLMs, crawlers,
and archival ingest tools such as the Irish Traditional Music Archive, ITMA).

## Compositions (5)

- [Perpetual Light (air, G)](https://beta.billymccomiskey.com/?tune=perpetual-light) — At the beginning of the COVID-19 epidemic in 2020, The Irish Arts Center in New York commissioned Billy to compose an air and a reel. _(placeholder notation)_
- [Clear as Mud (reel, G)](https://beta.billymccomiskey.com/?tune=clear-as-mud) — This was a phrase Billy's mother, Mae McComiskey would use if she was having trouble understanding something. _(placeholder notation)_
- [The Controversial (reel, G)](https://beta.billymccomiskey.com/?tune=the-controversial) — Billy first titled this tune Maureen Glynn's.
- [Ohm's Law (jig, D)](https://beta.billymccomiskey.com/?tune=ohms-law) — Ohm's Law is a formula used to calculate the relationship between voltage, current and resistance in an electrical circuit.
- [The Diamond (waltz, D)](https://beta.billymccomiskey.com/?tune=the-diamond) — My great-great-great grandfather was a poor cobbler who lived in the foothills of the Carpathian Mountains in Transylvania.

## Full data

- Structured JSON (canonical): https://beta.billymccomiskey.com/data/tunes.json
- Structured JSON (discography): https://beta.billymccomiskey.com/data/albums.json
- Full catalog in markdown (stories + notation): https://beta.billymccomiskey.com/llms-full.txt

## Data model: `Tune`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | URL-safe stable identifier (kebab-case). |
| `title` | string | Display title, e.g. "The Diamond". |
| `rhythm` | string | Tune type: `reel`, `jig`, `slip jig`, `hornpipe`, `polka`, `slide`, `waltz`, `air`, `march`, `barndance`. |
| `key` | string | Musical key, e.g. `G`, `Dmaj`, `Amaj`. |
| `narrative` | string | The historical story behind the composition. |
| `credits` | object | `composer`, optional `storyBy`, optional `editor`. |
| `archivalMetadata` | object | `sourceCollection`, `rightsHolder`, `recordingDate` — shaped to match ITMA ingest. |
| `abcNotation` | string | Standard ABC notation, rendered client-side via abcjs. |
| `notationSource` | string | Provenance of the notation: `official`, `thesession`, or `placeholder`. |

## Discography (10)

- 2009 — The Green Fields of America (Mick Moloney & Billy McComiskey with the Green Fields of America; role: ensemble; label: Compass Records)
- 2009 — The Pride of New York (The Pride of New York; role: member; label: Compass Records)
- 2008 — Absolutely Irish (Various Artists (a Mick Moloney project); role: guest; label: Compass Records)
- 2008 — Outside the Box (Billy McComiskey; role: solo; label: Compass Records)
- 1995 — Trian II (Trian; role: member; label: Green Linnet)
- 1992 — Trian (Trian; role: member; label: Flying Fish)
- 1985 — The Times We've Had (The Irish Tradition; role: member; label: Green Linnet)
- 1981 — Makin' the Rounds (Billy McComiskey; role: solo; label: Green Linnet (reissued by Compass))
- 1978 — The Corner House (The Irish Tradition; role: member; label: Green Linnet)
- 1976 — Catchin' the Tune (The Irish Tradition; role: member; label: A.Y. Productions (reissued by Smithsonian Folkways))

## Data model: `Album`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | URL-safe stable identifier (kebab-case). |
| `title` | string | Album title. |
| `year` | number | Release year. |
| `artist` | string | Billing/artist name on the release. |
| `role` | string | Billy's role: `solo`, `member`, `ensemble`, or `guest`. |
| `label` | string | Record label. |
| `personnel` | string | Notable players (optional). |
| `notes` | string | Editorial context (optional). |
| `links` | object | Optional outbound links (`bandcamp`, `spotify`, `appleMusic`, `compass`, `discogs`, `allmusic`). |
